scope: Xcode-built iOS/iPadOS reference host launched in iOS Simulator runtimes: Metal drawable presentation, ordered Latin+CJK font stack, scene activation and deterministic repaint, graceful retirement and process exit

checks.name: ipad_launch_and_metal_frame
checks.detail: Lifecycle Activate, window 2064x2648 physical at scale 2, Metal adapter 'Apple iOS simulator GPU', frame 1 readback background=4945816 button=496804 text=22852 pixels.

checks.name: ipad_activation_repaint
checks.detail: Engine-level tap at the button centre (516,708) activated the scene; the host rendered the pressed frame deterministically from about_to_wait instead of waiting for a UIKit RedrawRequested that a Metal-backed view may not deliver.

checks.name: iphone_launch_and_activation
checks.detail: Window 1206x2334 at scale 3 (402x778 logical); frame 1 background=2376118 button=393088 text=45598 pixels; tap at (201,435) activated and repainted; ios_host=pass frames=2 activations=1 retired=true.

checks.name: chinese_font_stack
checks.detail: The screenshots show the Chinese title line and the 激活 Activate button rendered with real glyphs from the compiled-in DejaVuSans + DroidSansFallbackFull stack; text ink is counted separately from background and button pixels.

checks.name: graceful_retirement
checks.detail: The host writes its summary (ios_host=pass ... retired=true) to the log file and terminates the process; winit documents ActiveEventLoop::exit as a no-op on iOS, so the reference host ends scripted runs explicitly.

limits: Simulator runtime only; the same build has not been installed on a physical device yet.
